quote: On January 20, three large Ship-To-Shore container cranes(STS), manufactured by Qingdao Hisea Heavy-duty Machinery Co.,Ltd. for the Antioquia Port in Colombia, were successfully dispatched. These cranes have a rated lifting capacity of 65 tons under the spreader, a forward outreach of 60 meters, and a lifting height of 54 meters above the rail.
note: Opened HHMC company English news page 2026-10-02.
